Taxes and fees at Lucerne hotels

At the 14 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 8% ($12 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 3% at Hotel Luzernerhof to 12% at Barabas Hotel Luzern. At 4 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
